title: Capability: apply table-defined charge loss from external item events
description:
Add a provider-neutral, fail-closed path for an external event on an item state machine to deduct the source-defined amount from that item’s economy. The concrete retained case is Cube of Force: when its barrier is targeted by listed spells or contacts listed effects, the event must resolve the matching table:cube-of-force-charges-lost row and deduct the printed charges without charging the item owner’s action.

Current gap: item_state_event accepts instanceId and an exact condition, then applies a state transition; it has no event context or economy-deduction input. Cube of Force therefore keeps its full source predicate on each face self-loop, but the event effect cannot execute and the enclosing machine remains engine-pending. Do not infer a table row or charge amount from prose or invent a new deduction mechanism without an explicit contract.
acceptance_criteria:
Define explicit inputs, exclusions, identity/revision, residual DM interpretation, and fail-closed behavior for missing or ambiguous event context. Bind the operation to the generated item condition/effect/table reference. Implement deterministic economy mutation for a uniquely resolved table row with no owner action/resource cost. Add generated-pack conformance proving the real Cube of Force representation drives the deduction, and prove unknown/unmatched events leave both state and charges unchanged.
- item_state_event REFUSES atomically (no state, economy, or timer change; no success result) any condition transition whose effects it cannot execute; effectless condition events keep working. (PR #663 review P2, user 2026-10-14.)
- A condition SELF-LOOP (from == to) preserves pending timers and cooldown anchors unless the source explicitly authorizes a reset; Cube of Force same-face contact must not restart the 1-minute barrier duration. Permanent evidence on a configured Cube face and on the Immovable Rod DC 30 self-loop.
- Pre-freeze: blocks eshyra-o9bd.14.
